project.name: Four versus five sites: thermal-volume persistence
project.subtitle: Matched mean occupation 2K/L=2: (L,K)=(4,4) and (5,5), singlet dimensions 105 and 1,176. Complete and ring graphs at t=1,U=20, plus free and no-hopping controls. Intermediate-temperature nonmonotonicity persists; the pronounced four-site complete-graph low-temperature collapse does not.
